description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.
 The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.
 We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer with strong full-stack software engineering expertise to modernize Mainframe Identity and Access Management (IAM) security controls and services. The engineer will independently design and deliver secure applications, APIs, integrations, and automation using Java, Spring Boot, React, and modern web services, while partnering with Mainframe security specialists on IBM z/OS and RACF capabilities.

 The Engineer will advance the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of reliable software solutions for Mainframe IAM security. The role combines hands-on full-stack engineering with least-privilege access management, self-service security workflows, control automation, and event-driven security observability. The engineer will collaborate across software engineering, Cybersecurity, Mainframe technology, and product teams to address complex technical challenges and deliver measurable improvements.
 Key Responsibilities include: 
 Full Stack Engineering:  Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure frontend and backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and RESTful web services. 

 Mainframe IAM Modernization:  Build and enhance API-driven services that modernize RACF security administration, access management workflows, and security control operations across IBM z/OS environments. 

 Mainframe Integration:  Develop reusable Java integration components for authorized interactions with RACF information, z/OS UNIX System Services (USS), and Mainframe datasets through supported interfaces such as Zowe and z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF). 

 Access Management Security Controls:  Implement and improve authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, privileged access management, and multi-factor authentication integrations in partnership with Mainframe security specialists. 

 Self-Service and Automation:  Engineer secure self-service applications and automated workflows for approved access requests, security administration, control validation, exception handling, and auditability. 

 Event-Driven Integration and Analytics:  Build services using Apache Kafka and enterprise analytics warehouse integrations to collect, process, and make security events, control metrics, and operational insights available to authorized consumers. 

 Cybersecurity Observability:  Enhance security monitoring, logging, alerting, and visibility into access management activities and control exceptions, including integration with Mainframe security event monitoring solutions. 

 Secure Software Development:  Embed secure design, code review, automated testing, input validation, sensitive-data protection, vulnerability remediation, and security controls throughout the software development lifecycle. 

 Reliability and Delivery:  Improve application performance, maintainability, CI/CD, test automation, troubleshooting, production support, and operational resilience across distributed and Mainframe integrations. 

 AI-Based Engineering and Automation:  Apply approved AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools to improve software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, security analysis, and automation; validate generated outputs and maintain security safeguards, human oversight, and accountability. 

 Technical Collaboration:  Analyze complex requirements, evaluate technical approaches, document solutions, conduct code reviews, share knowledge with peers, and collaborate with product, business, and security teams to deliver outcomes aligned with enterprise objectives .

 
 The ideal candidate is a hands-on, collaborative engineer who can independently solve complex application and integration challenges, apply secure engineering practices, and work effectively with specialists in Mainframe IAM technologies.
 Required Qualifications:
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred.

 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise applications and services.

 Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and RESTful API/web service development.

 Experience with software architecture and integration patterns, Git-based collaboration, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and application troubleshooting.

 Working knowledge of IBM z/OS and RACF security concepts, including users, groups, resource profiles, access permissions, and least-privilege principles.

 Familiarity with USS, Mainframe Datasets, and programmatic access to Mainframe resources through supported interfaces.

 Understanding of IAM security controls, authentication, authorization, privileged access management, multi-factor authentication, and secure handling of sensitive information.

 Working knowledge of Apache Kafka or comparable messaging technologies and familiarity with enterprise analytics warehouse and security event integration concepts.

 Experience applying secure coding, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, logging, and reliability practices to enterprise applications.

 Experience using approved AI-assisted engineering tools with appropriate validation of AI-generated code and recommendations.

 Demonstrated ability to independently address complex technical problems and collaborate effectively across engineering, cybersecurity, and product teams.

  
 Additional Preferred Qualifications:
 Hands-on experience with Zowe APIs/SDKs/CLI or z/OSMF REST services and Java integration with RACF, USS, or Mainframe datasets.

 Experience implementing or integrating Mainframe privileged access management and multi-factor authentication solutions.

 Experience automating RACF user/group administration, resource access workflows, and security control validation.

 Familiarity with Mainframe security event monitoring and analytics solutions, including SMF-based security event processing.

 Hands-on experience with Kafka producers/consumers, streaming integrations, and security data pipelines to analytics warehouses.

 Experience developing IAM self-service portals, secure administration APIs, and operational observability dashboards.

 Exposure to SQL/NoSQL databases, containers, DevSecOps, and enterprise monitoring platforms.

 Experience applying agentic AI or AI-enabled automation within secure software engineering or cybersecurity workflows.

 Experience delivering technology solutions in highly regulated environments with strong audit and risk requirements.

 Depending on factors such as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, American Express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions.

 
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation,  shared values  and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
